scope:
Opaque-origin DOM fixture for the production memo and shared auth runtime.
Uses memory Storage, fixture fetch and an asset-loader substitution. It does NOT
verify real Storage persistence, Web Locks, cross-tab behavior or the React dialog.

checks.name: production memo mounts with existing draft
memo and canonical application runtime join one same-tab issuance
actual memo transient refresh failure keeps owner
401 reports recovery without replacing credentials or leaking event tokens
actual memo rejects wrong-owner successful response
explicit session change does not delete current editor or fixture Storage
